dataset.split_policy: Whole semantic families; English and Italian variants stay together.

verification.oracle_scope: Literal expected outputs, invalid inputs, state retention and isolation, defensive copies, failure atomicity, classic-browser VM execution, and DOM-double submit/back/error transitions.

limitations: This compact synthetic curriculum is not a large representative production corpus.
Thirty-eight didactic groups derive from two core templates and one form layout.
Reference tests and external execution oracles share engineer-authored specifications; neither measures model capability.
No inference responses, human approvals, user studies or Level D qualifications are claimed by these records.
Training and candidate qualification are separate experiments; this report admits reference data only.

posthoc_known_limitations.finding: All 76 frozen v1 reference bundles omit the result TEXT marker ELM-005. The earlier validator skipped TEXT elements, so historical admission did not enforce that marker.
posthoc_known_limitations.future_generator_change: Only future generated references receive the missing marker; no replacement v1 dataset or retraining has been produced.
posthoc_known_limitations.interpretation: Historical reference admission and training completion are preserved; neither establishes model correctness or qualification under the revised validator.
posthoc_known_limitations.instruction_scope: Historical V11 instructed markers only on interactive elements; subsequent V12 explicitly includes TEXT. Missing TEXT markers under revised validation are not attributed to disobeying the original V11 instruction.
